description: The Cincinnati Insurance Company was founded by four independent insurance agents, and 2025 marked 75 years in business. Cincinnati Financial Corporation is a regulated holding company that transacts substantially all of its business through its subsidiaries, and through The Cincinnati Insurance Company it is one of the 25 largest property casualty insurers in the nation based on net written premium volume, among more than 2,000 U.S. stock and mutual companies. The mission established by its founders continues to guide the company: to grow profitably and enhance the ability of local independent insurance agents to deliver quality financial protection to the people and businesses they serve by providing insurance market stability through financial strength, producing competitive, up-to-date products and services, and developing associates committed to superior service. At year-end 2025 a select group of independent agencies in 46 states actively marketed its property casualty insurance within their communities.
